# Mateo Rumac

> Portfolio of Mateo Rumac, a full-stack developer building production web applications with React, Astro, PHP, MySQL, REST APIs, Stripe integrations, dashboards, and multilingual interfaces.

The primary language version of this site is English, with Croatian equivalents for the main pages.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage (EN)](https://mateorumac.com/en/): Main portfolio homepage with project highlights, career timeline, technical skills, and contact section.
- [Homepage (HR)](https://mateorumac.com/hr/): Croatian version of the homepage.
- [Resume (EN)](https://mateorumac.com/en/resume/): Resume page with summary, experience, selected projects, skills, education, and contact links.
- [Resume (HR)](https://mateorumac.com/hr/resume/): Croatian version of the resume page.

## Projects

- [Easeful](https://tryeaseful.com/en): Financial decision product focused on life runway and time-cost framing.
- [Easeful App](https://app.tryeaseful.com): Live app experience for Easeful.
- [DevTools](https://mateorumac.com/tools/): Privacy-first browser toolkit for image conversion, favicon and Open Graph generation, contrast checking, launch auditing, and related workflows.
- [MealMate](https://mateorumac.com/apps/mealmate/): Local-first household meal-planning PWA with a deterministic rules and scoring engine for nutrition targets, dietary constraints, and learned taste preferences.
- [Nightfall](https://mateorumac.com/game/): Browser arcade flight game built with Three.js, WebGL, and procedural terrain streaming.
- [D&A Property Management](https://danda.hr): Direct booking platform with multilingual booking flows, landlord profit calculator, and role-based dashboards.
- [D&A Smart Solutions](https://dandaweb.com): Company web-development branch site with parallax hero, portfolio carousel, pricing, and contact flow.
- [Apposta Lei](https://appostalei.com): Multilingual hospitality distributor website with product and brand hubs, galleries, and SEO-focused structure.
- [Meštri od Broda](https://mestriodbroda.hr): Superyacht painting and refit company site with project gallery, reviews, and quote-request contact flow.
- [Mind Well](https://mindwell.hr): Corporate wellness website with Markdown blog, pricing pages, and cookie consent integration.
- [Gran Caffe Monaco](https://grancaffe.mc): Restaurant website with menu, gallery, events, contact pages, and booking widget integration.
- [Hotel Natura](https://hotel-natura.com): Hotel website with custom direct booking flow, live availability and rates, and amenities gallery.
- [Rent a Boat Zadar](https://rentaboatzadareu.com): Multilingual charter website with fleet pages, destination content, pricing tables, and inquiry flow.
- [LunaSky Bay](https://lunasky-bay.com): Mobile-home rental website with availability calendar, gallery, reviews, and multilingual property pages.
- [Taxi Kamidi](https://taxi-kamidi.com/en): Taxi company website with smooth-scroll presentation, fleet showcase, services, and multilingual contact flow.
